title: party artefact
description: One signed file per party (policy-composition ticket 11, spec.md 'The party artefact'; ADR-0012, ADR-0013). Declares the party's name, its roles, its parents as party+kind+version(+name for a feed), its selected baseline name, and its overlay. Eco-system ticket 21 / ADR-0019 widened it: the parent kind enum closed to controls|implementations|feed with a free feed `name` and an optional `since`; `publishes[]` became the discovery record (there is no central catalogue -- the set of signed publisher artefacts IS the catalogue); `size`, `appetite` and `reporting_currency` became the signed facts the pricing seam reads (ticket 25, ADR-0020/0021) so no fixture prices a party; `overlay.floor` became the party's own tighten-only cage floor (ticket 26, ADR-0022). `baseline` is required only of a party that adopts. The single source of truth for the allowed roles and parent kinds -- party_artefact.py reads its enums from this file rather than re-declaring them.

money.description: Every amount carries its currency. No sum crosses perspectives or currencies (spec.md, 'The £ seam').

party.description: The party this artefact declares, e.g. 'driftwood'.

roles.description: CONTEXT.md's Role entry. Roles compose; this is not a partition. `platform` is the substrate role -- only a platform-role party may declare the `infra` cage tier on a Namespace (ADR-0022). `insurer` quotes against another party's signed exposure.

baseline.description: The named baseline this party selects from its controls parent, e.g. 'MODERATE'. May be widened by an overlay add, never narrowed (ADR-0013). Required of a party whose roles include `adopter`; a pure publisher selects nothing.

inherits.description: Every parent this party pins, as party+kind+version. The version is the tag this party already pins in its own Flux/Renovate files. A `feed` parent also names the feed; the entry IS the subscription record (ADR-0019: no second record).

kind.description: controls: a catalogue + named baselines. implementations: policy bodies + control claims. feed: anything that prices and carries no rules. Closed, because the composer does three different things with a parent and nothing else; the feed `name` underneath is free, so a new publisher ships a new feed with no platform change (ADR-0019).

name.description: The feed's name, e.g. 'penalty-schema'. Required when kind is feed; meaningless otherwise.

since.description: The date this party first pinned this parent. Optional; a subscription with no `since` is simply undated, never invalid.

publishes.description: The discovery record (ADR-0019 point 5). What this party publishes, where it lives in this repo, and which versions it has withdrawn. There is no central catalogue: the set of signed publisher artefacts is the catalogue.

path.description: Repo-relative directory this artefact is published from.

payload_schema.description: Repo-relative path or URL of the payload schema a consumer validates against. Null or absent where the artefact is not a feed envelope.

revoked.description: Versions this party has withdrawn. Tags are never deleted; a pin to a revoked version is a priced hole, never a refusal (ADR-0019 point 6, ADR-0023).

size.description: The party's own signed size. The percent-of-turnover and per-subject formulas scale against these numbers, so the price is this party's and no fixture's (ticket 25, ADR-0020). A stale `as_of` widens to the cap; it never refuses.

appetite.description: The party's own risk tolerance, as a signed fact rather than a platform-held fixture (ticket 25). The tier selection reads this.

reporting_currency.description: The currency this party's own balance sheet reports in. Defaults to USD where unstated; the UK parties declare GBP.

add.description: Members this party ships itself, versioned with its own composed artefact.

restate.description: An inherited ValidatingPolicy and the action this party wants for it. Stricter is accepted; weaker is a declared inability, caged and priced, never an override.

controls.description: Bare catalogue control ids (ticket 14; ADR-0013, ADR-0017) this party adds to its selected baseline, beyond what the baseline name already selects. May only grow: a composition refuses on any id that leaves the last signed composed artefact's selected set. Optional; defaults to none.

floor.description: One tighten-only cage floor this party holds itself to, whatever the price selects (ticket 26, ADR-0022). Selection clamps up to it and never below it. Lowering it is priced as a delta, never refused. `infra` is deliberately absent: only a platform-role party declares infra, and it declares it on a Namespace manifest, not here.
